questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Dominican Republic?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Dominican Republic article.

questions.proof: Its capital, and largest city, is Santo Domingo.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Dominican Republic?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Dominican Republic article.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The Dominican Republic is a Latin American country on the Caribbean island of Hispaniola; the other country on the island is _____.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “island”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Dominican Republic article.

questions.proof: The Dominican Republic is a Latin American country on the Caribbean island of Hispaniola; the other country on the island is Haiti.
